sql: SELECT fire_year, COUNT(*) AS fire_count, SUM(COALESCE(final_acres, gis_acres)) AS total_acres FROM disasters.wildfire_perimeters WHERE fire_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2026 GROUP BY fire_year ORDER BY fire_year; SELECT MAX(fire_year), MIN(fire_year), COUNT(*) FROM disasters.wildfire_perimeters;
